svg.title: One skill implementation with supported host adapters
svg.desc: One canonical skill and its local resources can be distributed through a compatible package or native adapter to Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Shared format does not imply identical discovery, permissions, or runtime behavior.
